1_executive_email.body:
Dear Medtronic (Strata valve team) Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Medtronic (Strata valve team).

## Technology
P-01 — Multi-segment CSF shunt with Bayesian occlusion prediction and pre-emptiv

## Why This May Matter to Medtronic (Strata valve team), Integra Lifesciences, or Sophysa
Obstruction causes 30-50% of shunt failures. Predictive multi-segment shunt could reduce revisions by 30%. That is a $124M/yr value opportunity for the shunt market.

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T2-CONDITIONAL
- Physical validation: PARTIAL
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)
- Strict dual-invariant FALSIFIED (peak 22>20 mmHg)
- 24h survival not achieved
- FDA nozzle benchmark 72% disagreement (different geometry, not P-01's)

## What We Are Asking
Request technical evaluation. Commission the validation experiment ($3-5K (ESTIMATED: COTS components)) OR request a license/co-development discussion. This is the most mature package type but physical validation is still outstanding.

## Validation Investment
A defined experiment ($$3-5K bench + $50K+ for 3D multi-segment mesh, 12-24 months to T3) can upgrade this from T2-CONDITIONAL to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular

3_buyer_specific_reason.ideal_buyer: Medtronic (Strata valve team), Integra Lifesciences, or Sophysa
3_buyer_specific_reason.buyer_type: Shunt OEM with computational modeling capability
3_buyer_specific_reason.strategic_reason: Obstruction causes 30-50% of shunt failures. Predictive multi-segment shunt could reduce revisions by 30%. That is a $124M/yr value opportunity for the shunt market.
3_buyer_specific_reason.why_this_buyer_would_care: First-mover advantage in predictive shunt technology. Existing shunt OEMs have the clinical relationships and manufacturing base to capitalize. The computational work is done — they bring physical validation and clinical translation.
3_buyer_specific_reason.capabilities_required: Multi-segment catheter manufacturing, flow sensor integration, computational fluid dynamics, clinical trial infrastructure

5_nda_cda_trigger.trigger_point: When buyer requests full technical dossier (07_PREMIUM_DOSSIER.json) or evidence ledger
5_nda_cda_trigger.what_is_shared_pre_nda: This one-page summary + executive email. No proprietary data, no full evidence ledger, no model code.
5_nda_cda_trigger.what_is_shared_post_nda: Full 15-section dossier, evidence ledger with source artifacts, experiment protocols, model code references, competitive analysis, IP diligence status.
5_nda_cda_trigger.nda_template_note: Use standard mutual NDA. CereVascular provides technology disclosure; buyer provides evaluation feedback. Both sides protect confidential information.
5_nda_cda_trigger.timeline_for_nda: Typically executed within 1-2 weeks of initial interest expression

6_technical_diligence_path.step_1_initial_review: Buyer reviews one-page summary + executive email (30 min)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_3_full_dossier_review: Buyer's technical team reviews full dossier + evidence ledger (1-2 weeks)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_4_technical_qa: Conference call with CereVascular technical team (1 hour)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_5_validation_decision: Buyer decides: commission validation experiment, request co-development, or pass
6_technical_diligence_path.step_6_if_validation: Buyer funds experiment → external party executes → data ingested via R341 pipeline → T2 upgrade → license discussion
6_technical_diligence_path.step_7_if_license: Term sheet negotiation → exclusive license or co-development agreement
6_technical_diligence_path.estimated_total_timeline: 4-8 weeks from initial contact to validation decision; 3-6 months from validation to license

validation_investment.experiment: 3D multi-segment CFD mesh on actual patient geometry + V0 bench prototype: 4-segment shunt + COTS sensors + Arduino, 30 obstruction scenarios
validation_investment.success_threshold: Advance to next development phase (see Development Plan)
validation_investment.co_validation_strategy: Buyer funds $3-5K bench prototype → receives evaluation rights + data sharing → if multi-segment advantage confirmed, co-development → exclusive license
